results.title: Biden said wages are up. Inflation went up more.

results.title: Real Earnings - August 2023
results.snippet: Real average hourly earnings for all employees increased 0.5 percent, seasonally adjusted, from August 2022 to August 2023.

results.title: Real Earnings - October 2023
results.snippet: Real average hourly earnings for all employees increased 0.8 percent, seasonally adjusted, from October 2022 to October 2023.

results.title: Inflation Continues to Outpace Wages, Data Shows | The Center Square YT
results.snippet: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics tracks “real” average hourly earnings, which are wages of Americans with rising inflation taken into account. “From February 2022 to February 2023, real average hourly earnings decreased 0.3 percent, seasonally adjusted,” BLS said. “The change in real average hourly earnings combined with a decrease of 0.9 percent in the average workweek resulted in a 1.2-percent decrease in real average weekly earnings over this period.”

results.title: Biden touts higher wages: Here’s how paychecks have changed
results.snippet: Last month, inflation-adjusted average hourly wages rose 1.4% from a year earlier, according to data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) released Tuesday. January’s uptick marked the ninth consecutive month of year-over-year real hourly wage growth after two years when workers saw their gains erased by inflation.
